Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by manually implementing the SomeAnnotation interface in the HelloAnnotationImpl class without overriding the equals and hashCode methods. This causes the manual annotation instance to not be equal to the annotation instance retrieved from the method, even though they have the same values.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling Foo.showBug(), which compares a manually created annotation instance with one obtained from a method's declared annotations. Since HelloAnnotationImpl does not override equals and hashCode, the comparison returns false, demonstrating the bug.
